LESSON: GUIDED WRITING CLARITY PUNCTUATION GRAMMAR

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: FRENCH
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing Handwriting Orthography Vocabulary By the end of the 
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is correct punctuation important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use language to convey short written interactive messages
2. construct relatively long simple texts
3. appreciate the role of writing in interactive communication contexts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING CLARITY PUNCTUATION GRAMMAR
This lesson teaches Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar for Grade 7 FRENCH.

STUDY STEPS
1. use language to convey short written interactive messages
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. construct relatively long simple texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of writing in interactive communication contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar above.
2. Explain Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing Clarity Punctuation Grammar important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is correct punctuation important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use language to convey short written interactive messages
2. construct relatively long simple texts
3. appreciate the role of writing in interactive communication contexts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
